agent_notes: 20/20 web searches used; no source directly and unambiguously documents a 'Motasar' village inside Lunkaransar tehsil / Mahajan sub-tehsil / the Mahajan Field Firing Range. The only administratively documented 'Motasar' in Bikaner district is a separate village in Kolayat tehsil (gram panchayat Gadiyala, pop. 443 in 2011), ~90km from Mahajan — almost certainly a different place that merely shares the name. The official 2011-era village list for Lunkaransar tehsil (mapsofindia) does NOT contain a 'Motasar' entry, but it does contain the single merged entry 'Mahajan Fieldfiring Range' plus sever
